listing.name: Road Rash / road-sdl2-rash (speedydevil007)
listing.summary: Modern native 64-bit C port and WebAssembly release of Road Rash (1996 PC). Runs natively on Windows 10/11, Linux, Steam Deck, and Web Browsers via SDL2. Features gamepad support,   1280x960 high-res rendering, SoundFont audio, in-game options overlay, and real-time physics/AI modding
